svg.aria-label: Before: Ranjit reads from paper, looks down, his slide is full of small text and his phone rings while the audience laughs or gets bored. After: he opens with “Today, I’d like to talk about the causes and effects of stress”, tells a personal story, smiles and makes eye contact; his phone is off and the audience leans in.
